name: claudish-to-english
description: Automatically append plain-language rewrites and rewrite answers or Markdown on demand using a model chosen by the user.

interface.shortDescription: Rewrite answers and documents with a chosen model.
interface.longDescription: Automatically append a plain-language rewrite after each answer using a trusted Stop hook. Agentish Rewriter also delegates on-demand answer and Markdown rewrites to the requested model.
defaultPrompt: Use $agentish-rewriter to rewrite my last answer with the model I specify.
